The reference Gray_Mold stem image shows a tan/brown lesion (later stage after sporulation), while the test image shows the active phase with the characteristic dense gray powdery spore mass on the stem - both consistent with Botrytis (Gray Mold). The gray dusty coating in the test image is the hallmark "dense velvety gray-brown spore mass" described in the symptom description.
